source_title: Staged TCM treatment for suspected pulmonary inflammatory pseudotumor: a case report
paraphrase_note: Symptoms/tongue/pulse paraphrased by the harness author from the open-access full text; source pattern and principle are the authors' own.
chief_complaint: Intermittent dry cough since an upper respiratory infection; imaging showed a 3-cm lung mass the patient chose not to operate on.
symptoms: no other major complaints recorded in the summary
tongue_as_reported: enlarged with teeth marks, pale-red body, white coating; sublingual veins distended later
source_pattern: Phlegm-dampness (Spleen weakness) with wind-phlegm obstructing the Lung, later phlegm plus blood stasis
source_treatment_principle: Disperse wind, ventilate the Lung, resolve phlegm and relieve cough; later resolve phlegm, soften masses, move blood and support healthy Qi
